headline: The PR renames the doubling helper to `double`.

glossary.meaning: A small function that other code calls.

caller-uses-removed-helper.title: New code on main still calls the old helper

points.label: What happens
points.text: `caller.py` on `main` calls `old_helper`. The PR removes it.

points.label: Why it matters
points.text: Git merges the two without a conflict, but `caller.py` then fails when it starts.

claims.text: The test merge still calls it.
The import fails at run time. I did not run it.
Other branches probably call it too.

fixes.label: Fix the caller in the merge
Keep a short alias
fixes.detail: Add `old_helper = double` to `app.py` until the callers move.

points.label: What happens
points.text: The PR changes `total`, and no test calls it.

claims.text: Only `app.py` uses `total`, so one test covers every caller.

done_well.text: The new name says what the helper does.

notes: All six reviewers returned results. A note with `</script><!--` in it stays text.
